title: Audit: Red Tape Under Review
description: Audit: Red Tape Under Review — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Soldier Clohz of Yorbahk

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go Collect 30 Performance Reviews and 15 Stack Rankings from the Fire Fade Leaders in the Widowers Nest.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Soldier Clohz of Yorbahk

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Widower's Nest

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go Collect 30 Performance Reviews and 15 Stack Rankings from the Fire Fade Leaders in the Widowers Nest.

Offer:

Its time for the semi-daily reviews and the Fire Fade Leaders in the Widower's Nest need a little incentive to get them done. Can you go in and work your brand of motivation to get me those Performance Reviews and Stack Rankings?

Schedule one on ones for each of the Fade Leaders and meet with them about their progress with the Performance Reviews. I need you to collect the Performance Reviews and Stack Rankings from the Fire Fade Leaders in the Widower's Nest. Once you get them return to me, Soldier Clohz of Yorbahk, on Level 1 of the Widower's Nest.

Turn-in:

You are one amazing human resource! Give me a nod when you are up to do this again.

Objectives:

  • Performance Reviews ×30
  • Stack Rankings ×15

Level range: 20–40
